description: Election Commission - Mr. W. Wiwekanandan of the Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha has Valeted his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha - Mr. M. I. Usanar of the Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha - Mr. K. M. D. R. Kulathunga of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and vacancies.
